preserved_classes.Entity: Opaque directory entity reference; no runtime identity or authority inferred.
preserved_classes.Person: Human directory entity, subclass of Entity.
preserved_classes.Agent: Automated directory entity, subclass of Entity.
preserved_classes.Organization: Collective directory entity, subclass of Entity.
preserved_classes.Actor: Compatibility alias equivalent to Entity; do not reinterpret as an authorization principal.

separations.literary_character: Book Nook Character has no subclass or equivalence relation to Rolodex Person.
separations.attribution: A local reader ID, Rolodex Entity reference and Castalia holder key are distinct identifiers. Linking requires explicit evidence.
separations.authority: Credential presentation v2 plus independent issuer pins and current application permission are required.
separations.transport: Nostr public keys are explicitly bound to a Castalia holder through an authorized nostr.bind action.
